The two tutorial decks on the [Talks page](../../talks.qmd#fundamental-concepts-of-pkpd),
Introduction to Fundamental PK Concepts and Introduction to Fundamental PD
Concepts, were written for the 2018–2019 Novartis Academia-Industry
Quantitative Hackathon. A colleague later found errors in them. This project
corrects those errors in the working copies, republishes the PDFs, and records
a video to go with each deck.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). The decks, the error list, and
  the steps from correction to published video.
